## TRVI — Trevi Therapeutics (research as of 2026-06-21; price reviewed at 2026-06-18 close ~$17.19)

**1. Company / lead asset**
TRVI = Trevi Therapeutics (NASDAQ: TRVI). Lead program: **Haduvio (oral nalbuphine ER)**. Primary indication: **chronic cough in Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis (IPF-related chronic cough)**; second indication: **refractory chronic cough (RCC)**. [stocktitan 10-K](https://www.stocktitan.net/sec-filings/TRVI/10-k-trevi-therapeutics-inc-files-annual-report-012f40eefcd1.html); [trevitherapeutics.com](https://www.trevitherapeutics.com/)

**2. What drove the recent run (early-to-mid June 2026)**
No single discrete June data readout. The +28% move appears to be **catalyst anticipation + continuation of a year-long re-rating + sector/momentum**, not new clinical data:
- TRVI is up ~196% YTD on a sequence of de-risking events earlier in 2026: positive Phase 2b CORAL IPF-cough topline (~48–60% placebo-adjusted cough reduction), JAMA publication (Jan 22, 2026), and a successful FDA End-of-Phase-2 meeting (March 9, 2026) aligning Phase 3 design. [marketbeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/TRVI/forecast/); [JAMA PR](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/trevi-therapeutics-announces-publication-of-data-from-the-phase-2b-ipf-chronic-cough-trial-of-nalbuphine-er-in-the-journal-of-the-american-medical-association-jama-302668332.html)
- **June 3, 2026:** annual shareholder meeting approved doubling authorized shares 200M→400M and +8M to the incentive plan (financing-flexibility signal). [SEC 8-K trvi-20260603](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001563880/000119312526257365/trvi-20260603.htm); [Simply Wall St](https://simplywall.st/stocks/us/pharmaceuticals-biotech/nasdaq-trvi/trevi-therapeutics/news/trevi-therapeutics-trvi-is-up-105-after-seeking-major-share/amp)
- **June 17, 2026:** announced June/July event schedule — BIO International (June 22–25), Leerink Therapeutics Forum (July 14–15), ERS Cough Conference (July 15–17). [GlobeNewswire 2026-06-17](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/17/3313329/0/en/Trevi-Therapeutics-Announces-Upcoming-June-and-July-Event-Schedule.html)
- Analyst targets ratcheting up (Leerink to $25, Clear Street $29, Cantor $25, consensus ~$20.38, Strong Buy). [stockanalysis forecast](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/trvi/forecast/)
- Note: an Investing.com item also referenced a recent "52-week low at $13.68" — consistent with high volatility around the offering price; treat exact intraday levels as unverified. [investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/trevi-therapeutics-stock-hits-52week-low-at-1368-usd-93CH-4722256)

**3. Did the thesis materially improve, or price moved ahead of unchanged fundamentals?**
**Fundamentals essentially UNCHANGED in the last ~2 weeks** — the thesis-improving events (CORAL data, FDA alignment) occurred Jan–April 2026 and were already known. The June move looks like **price/sentiment running ahead of unchanged near-term fundamentals**, driven by anticipation of Phase 3 initiation and conference visibility, not fresh data. (Assessment based on absence of any new June clinical/regulatory catalyst in sources above.)

**4. Next known catalyst + timing**
- **First Phase 3 IPF-cough trial initiation — targeted Q2 2026 (i.e., by end of June 2026); second Phase 3 in H2 2026.** [Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/company-news/trevi-plans-two-phase-3-trials-for-chronic-cough-treatment-in-ipf-93CH-4549396)
- **Phase 2b RCC trial initiation — expected 1H 2026** (not confirmed initiated as of search date). [briefglance](https://briefglance.com/articles/trevis-strategic-gambit-targeting-chronic-cough-with-clinical-might)
- Conference visibility: BIO (June 22–25), ERS Cough Conference (July 15–17).
- **Pivotal topline data is far out: first Phase 3 topline 1H 2028; second Phase 3 topline 2H 2027.** [SEC 8-K ex99_1](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001563880/000119312526206382/trvi-ex99_1.htm)

**5. Is the next catalyst binary / oversized (easy money made)?**
The next *near-term* catalysts (Phase 3 *initiation*, conference presentations, possible RCC trial start) are **operational milestones, NOT binary efficacy readouts** — modest incremental value, low binary risk. The genuinely **binary, oversized** events (Phase 3 efficacy topline) are **12–24+ months away (2027–2028)**. So the heavily de-risking data (CORAL/EOP2) is already in the price; near-term has little fresh binary upside, while the big binary catalyst is distant.

**6. Financing / dilution flags**
- **April 2026: completed $150M underwritten offering — 11,600,000 shares at $13.00** (net ~$162M). [stocktitan 100M PR](https://www.stocktitan.net/news/TRVI/trevi-therapeutics-announces-pricing-of-100-million-underwritten-8milqzcsxf78.html); [424B5](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1563880/000119312526159041/d106297d424b5.htm)

- **Active ATM:** up to $200M with Leerink; ~4.5M shares / $14.6M sold under it as of April 15, 2026 — capacity remains. [424B5/ATM](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1563880/000119312526161582/d106297d424b5.htm)
- **June 3, 2026 share authorization doubling (200M→400M)** is a forward dilution-capacity flag — management explicitly maintaining financing/collaboration flexibility. [SEC 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001563880/000119312526257365/trvi-20260603.htm)

**7. Main risk, next 1–3 months**
- **Dilution risk:** well-capitalized into 2030 but just doubled authorized shares and has live ATM capacity — opportunistic raise into strength is plausible, a near-term overhang.
- **"Sell-the-news / no-news" pullback risk:** stock ran ~28% on anticipation/conference visibility with no new fundamentals; the next 1–3 months bring only operational milestones (trial starts), not data, so momentum could fade.
- No binary efficacy catalyst in the window to support the elevated price — gap between price and next value-inflection (2027–2028 topline).

**8. Key uncertainties / unverified**
- Could not confirm via live sources whether the first Phase 3 IPF trial or the Phase 2b RCC trial was *formally announced as initiated* in June 2026 — **unverified**.
- Exact share count as of latest 10-Q (post-offering) — **unverified** (cash ~$172M ending Q1; ~$334M pro forma confirmed).
- No discrete June 2026 clinical/regulatory press release identified that mechanically explains the +28% — **the run is best characterized as anticipation/momentum, not a confirmed hard catalyst.**
